articles.headline: Dell shares rise after company lifts fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
articles.summary: Dell raised its fiscal 2027 outlook on the back of strong AI server demand, underscoring that enterprise spending on AI infrastructure is still driving hardware revenue. For buyers, this can mean tighter supply, higher competition for capacity, and continued pressure on procurement timing and budgets.

articles.headline: ASML says AI boom has transformed customer sentiment as it breaks ground on new plant
articles.summary: ASML’s CFO said the AI boom has changed the mood among customers, a sign that demand for chipmaking tools remains tied to AI infrastructure spending. For businesses, this matters because wafer-fab equipment demand, lead times, and capacity planning can affect downstream chip supply and pricing.

articles.headline: Massachusetts executive order adds power and community requirements for large AI and cloud campuses
articles.summary: The new executive order ties permitting for large AI and cloud sites to clean-power procurement, grid-cost responsibility, and community approval. That can affect where companies place AI infrastructure, how fast projects get approved, and the true cost of expanding data-center capacity.
